title: How Questions Work showcase, slot template engine, and leaderboard stats
body:
HOW QUESTIONS WORK ARCHITECTURAL SHOWCASE
- Added an interactive "How Questions Work" page (/how-questions-work) exploring Countrydle's hybrid question-answering pipeline with live question flows, AST execution, and vector search retrieval.
- Added navigation links under About in the header and footer.

SLOT MASKING TEMPLATE ENGINE & NEIGHBOR COUNTS
- Introduced a high-speed slot masking and hashing template engine that matches parameterized natural-language questions in sub-millisecond time.
- Added collection length evaluation in AST plans across all game modes, answering questions comparing neighbor counts (e.g. "does it border at least 4 countries?") deterministically.

LEADERBOARD ENHANCEMENTS
- Average standings now calculate points per game across the current UTC calendar month alongside total monthly points.
- Added dedicated columns for Games Played, Total Wins, and Win Rate (%) with clear stat badges.
- Formatted point totals and counts with clean space separators (e.g. 1 250) for readability.

NEW PLAYER GUIDE & MAP INTERACTIONS
- Redesigned the new player guide with a decluttered progressive layout and first-visit display.
- Enhanced map candidate/eliminated markings with prominent borders and distinct backgrounds.
- Refined Flagdle layout and game controls.

UNIFIED GEMINI QUESTION FALLBACK & CONTACT UPDATES
- Switched secondary RAG question fallback from OpenAI to Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite across all game modes; restricted OpenAI strictly to embeddings.
- Updated direct support and feedback contact address to melzacki.jakub@gmail.com.
